title: Broken Redstone Lamp Mod
description: This project adds a broken redstone lamp. It adds another redstone lamp that doesn't work and doesn't do anything.
body: ![The broken lamp compared to the original lamp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49ce65493e79955a196747c036abb38461807f97.png)This mod adds a useless block for light decoration. The block is a Broken Redstone Lamp. To get it, you must have cheats enabled in your singleplayer world. Then, type in the chat: /give @s broken_redstone_lamp:broken_redstone_lamp
